about.title: About JanaSakshi AI
about.description: JanaSakshi AI is a civic-tech platform that helps citizens report public infrastructure issues — roads, water, sanitation, electricity — directly to the authorities responsible for fixing them. Every complaint is tracked from submission to resolution, so nothing falls through the cracks.
about.transparentDesc: Every complaint's status is visible to the citizen who filed it.
about.accountableDesc: Complaints are routed to the correct department for action.
about.verifiedDesc: Citizens confirm resolution with feedback once work is done.

cta.title: Ready to Make Your Voice Heard?

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, all complaint data is encrypted and stored securely. Only authorized personnel can access your information.
faq.q2: How long does it take to resolve a complaint?
faq.a2: Resolution time varies by complaint type. Most complaints are resolved within 7-14 days. You can track progress in real-time.
faq.q3: Can I submit complaints without registration?
faq.a3: No, registration is required to submit complaints and track their status. Registration takes less than 5 minutes.
faq.q4: What if I want to escalate my complaint?
faq.a4: If your complaint is not resolved within the stipulated time, it automatically escalates to higher authorities.
